description: For site visit, this log form records planned observations, coordination topics, quality checkpoints, progress claims, and unresolved prior items. Its supporting evidence includes field notes, representative photos, measurements, discussion record, and referenced drawing details.

use_case: Use the log form during construction site visit observation and follow-up when the site visit record must identify visit purpose, attendees, zones observed, work in progress, current documents, weather, and access limitations. Complete the applicable handoff for observation distribution, responsible-party response, follow-up dates, closed items, and project-record filing.
